items.title: AMWA BCP-005: NMOS Capability Mappings
items.text: This repository holds the suite overview for the BCP-005 series of AMWA Best Common Practices, part of the family of Networked Media Open Specifications from the Advanced Media Workflow Association.

items.title: What does the suite do?
items.text:
• The BCP-005 series defines mappings between external capabilities or protection technologies and the NMOS capability model.
  • It describes how NMOS Senders, Receivers, and Controllers declare and use support for specific technologies.

items.title: Why does it matter?
items.text:
• Consistent mappings allow Controllers to reason about endpoint capabilities using NMOS mechanisms.
  • The recommendations make technology-specific capabilities discoverable and interoperable without requiring vendor-specific extensions.

items.title: What are the recommendations?
items.text:
• BCP-005-01: NMOS EDID to Receiver Capabilities Mapping
  • BCP-005-02: NMOS Support for IPMX/HKEP
  • BCP-005-03: NMOS Support for IPMX/PEP

items.title: Getting started
items.text:
Choose the recommendation for the capability or protection technology being integrated:

  • BCP-005-01 for EDID-to-capability mapping
  • BCP-005-02 for IPMX/HKEP
  • BCP-005-03 for IPMX/PEP

There is more information about the NMOS Specifications and their GitHub repositories at https://specs.amwa.tv/nmos.

items.title: Introduction
items.text:
The BCP-005 series defines mappings between external capabilities or protection technologies and the NMOS capability model. These recommendations make technology-specific endpoint capabilities discoverable and usable by NMOS Controllers.

The suite currently includes:

  • BCP-005-01: NMOS EDID to Receiver Capabilities Mapping describes how EDID information is expressed through Receiver Capabilities.
  • BCP-005-02: NMOS Support for IPMX/HKEP describes support for HDCP over IP streaming using IPMX/HKEP.
  • BCP-005-03: NMOS Support for IPMX/PEP describes support for Privacy-encrypted streaming using IPMX/PEP.

The recommendations should be read alongside:

  • BCP-004-01: NMOS Receiver Capabilities
  • BCP-004-02: NMOS Sender Capabilities
  • IS-04: NMOS Discovery and Registration
  • IS-05: NMOS Device Connection Management
  • NMOS Parameter Registers
